affected_system: coastal protection, evacuation, and long-term adaptation system
alternatives: compare phased elevation recipients with not-yet-treated properties
estimate voluntary acquisition effects on loss and relocation stability
evaluate heterogeneous effects by tenure and baseline vulnerability
assumptions: Elevation, surge, shoreline, asset, and population layers share documented vertical and horizontal datums.
Sea-level pathways, damage functions, and adaptation performance remain explicit scenarios.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: Eligible exposed properties continue without the phased adaptation offer.

constraints.description: Selection, insurance, mobility, spillovers, attrition, and displacement outcomes must be pre-specified and observed.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: coastal resilience director and emergency-management commissioner
decision_question: Did phased elevation or voluntary acquisition reduce verified loss and displacement burden?

independence_key.binding_constraint: Selection, insurance, mobility, spillovers, attrition, and displacement outcomes must be pre-specified and observed.
independence_key.decision_object: phased property elevation and voluntary acquisition program
independence_key.evidence_gate: Assignment timing, comparable properties, pre-trends, hazard intensity, verified loss panels, moves, and spillover tests pass.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: matched event-study evaluation across comparable exposed properties

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased property elevation and voluntary acquisition program, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in change in event-related verified loss
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal protection or equitable relocation from selected participant outcomes alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Assignment timing, comparable properties, pre-trends, hazard intensity, verified loss panels, moves, and spillover tests pass.

title: Evaluate property-level coastal adaptation effects
transportability_risks: Coastal morphology, tides, subsidence, protection standards, and evacuation behavior differ.
Long-horizon adaptation values depend on local finance, land tenure, and legal authority.
